prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Bohrium (Bh) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead, floor cushions and a sliding glass door
Time of day: dawn — the first pale light, cool and quiet, the sky just turning; the first pale light at the window, the room still dim.
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Outfit: a simple slip wedding dress with a long veil — in soft pastel butter yellow; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; right now — one strap — or one side of the neckline — has slipped down off her shoulder, baring that whole shoulder and the top of her arm; she leaves it as it is, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body facing the camera; camera at her eye level; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window; she is seen through window glass with faint reflections on it.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand gives a thumbs-up at chest height.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her hip.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: level lowered brow, steady unblinking eyes, mouth closed in a straight line, jaw set.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — bohrium: a heavy synthetic metal below manganese, technetium and rhenium, first made in 1981 in a research city by striking bismuth with chromium ions, and named for the physicist of a harbour city who in 1913 pictured the atom as nested orbits stacked at fixed levels, where an electron may stand only on certain rings and gives off one exact colour of light whenever it leaps from one level down to another, explaining the red, cyan and violet lines of glowing hydrogen; first proposed under his full name, then shortened, though it sounds like boron; its longest-lived forms last only seconds to minutes — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: strong and broad-shouldered with firm muscle, yet full-busted with wide rounded hips and a defined waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
